title: Find the First Occurrence of a Pattern
description: Given two strings `haystack` and `needle`, return the index of the first occurrence of `needle` in `haystack`, or `-1` if `needle` is not part of `haystack`.
input_format: Two lines, first is `haystack`, second is `needle`.

hints: Check substrings of length equal to `needle` at every starting index.
KMP algorithm provides optimal O(n + m) worst-case time.
Python `haystack.find(needle)` returns the exact first index or -1.

reference_solution:
import sys
lines = sys.stdin.read().split()
if len(lines) >= 2:
    h, n = lines[0], lines[1]
    print(h.find(n))
else:
    print(-1)
